I replied to Tobias in their #central-random thread: the ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**.

It comes from #central-team, and Tobias is a member there, so he could see it himself. Hollis posted it on 9 Jun 2026 with the import attached to the ticket. There was one open problem: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports and creates duplicates. A ticket number is an operational fact, so no approval was needed.

I haven't seen anything after June about this ticket, so I don't know its current status.
